title: Transport units
subtitle: Fleet tractors and semi-trailers, with the positions of their tires.

dialog.createDescription: Enter the license plate and choose the axle configuration. Tire positions are generated automatically, with no tires assigned.

plate.label: License plate
plate.description: Format ABC123 or AB123CD. Spaces and hyphens are allowed.

preview.title: Axle layout: {{name}}
preview.empty: Choose a configuration to see its axle and tire layout.

validation.plateFormat: Enter a plate in the ABC123 or AB123CD format

feedback.duplicatePlate: A unit with that license plate already exists
feedback.forbidden: You don't have permission to register transport units
feedback.unexpected: We couldn't register the unit. Try again in a few minutes

noResults.title: No transport units found
noResults.description: Check the license plate or try fewer characters.

empty.title: There are no transport units registered yet
empty.description: Once registered, you will see them here.

error.title: Couldn't load the list
error.description: Check your connection and try again.

detail.description: Unit chassis and the tire mounted at each position.

notFound.title: This unit no longer exists
notFound.description: It may have been removed. Refresh the list.

error.title: Couldn't load the unit details
error.description: Check your connection and try again.

tire.label: Tire
tire.heading: Which tire are you mounting?
tire.hint: Search by serial number or filter by origin. Pick it with a click or Enter.

driver.label: Driver
driver.heading: Do you want to link a driver to the event?
driver.hint: Optional: it is recorded in the tire history. If it does not apply, choose Skip.
driver.placeholder: Search by last name, first name or ID
driver.empty: No drivers match that name or ID
driver.error: We could not load the drivers. You can skip this step

outgoing.title: This position already has a tire
outgoing.description: Tire {{serial}} ({{brand}}) will be unmounted and left waiting.

immutable.title: It is recorded in the history
immutable.description: The mounting is recorded in the tire history immutably, with the date and your user.

acknowledge.mount: I understand the mounting is recorded in the history and cannot be edited.
acknowledge.replace: I understand tire {{serial}} will be unmounted (left waiting) and the replacement is recorded in the history.

errors.slotTaken: While you were choosing, another tire was mounted in this position. Review the replacement and confirm again.
errors.tireUnavailable: The chosen tire is no longer available (it was mounted or changed situation). Choose another one.
errors.notFound: The tire, the driver or the position no longer exists. Review your selection.
errors.forbidden: You do not have permission to mount tires
errors.unexpected: We could not mount the tire. Try again in a few minutes
